package.name: hailo_benchmark_tools
package.description: Dataset-driven benchmarking tool for object detection ROS2 nodes (e.g. hailo_yolo_detector). Publishes images from a local folder one at a time, waits for the corresponding Detection2DArray response, and reports per-frame latency and effective FPS. no camera required. Works against any detector node's image-in/Detection2DArray-out topics, so the same dataset can be pointed at a Hailo pipeline or a CPU-only pipeline for a direct comparison.
